_comment: Canonical source of truth for Sibyl on-chain deployments. Update this file when (re)deploying or committing a new replay; README and tooling reference it.

SibylLedger._comment: Multi-market ledger (per-(agent,market) reputation, market registry, convictionIndex). Superseded the single-market ledger 0x847a6c5a32F5Ed69c43a82f46a84Df75f9B9Bd2A (storage layout changed, so it was redeployed, not migrated).

SibylVault._comment: ERC-4626 vault, LIVE on Mantle Sepolia. Base asset sUSD; routes through MetaVenue so it trades BOTH the Agni spot market (MNT-USD) and prediction markets (YES/NO via FPMM). Supersedes 0x88DF... (rewired from the Agni venue directly to the MetaVenue router).

MetaVenue._comment: IExecutionVenue router the vault points at; dispatches per market to a sub-venue. MNT-USD -> AgniExecutionVenue (spot), MNT-ABOVE-1.5-2026Q3 -> PredictionVenue (YES/NO).

PredictionVenue._comment: Prediction sub-venue behind the MetaVenue; buys/sells YES|NO via the FPMM, values positions at AMM/redemption price.

dex.name: Agni Finance — Uniswap-V3-style, live on Mantle Sepolia

markets._comment: 3 agents (momentum, onchain_oi, news) with lower reputation -> lower conviction; demonstrates conviction-ranked markets

predictionMarkets._comment: Vertical #2 — Gnosis CTF + FPMM binary prediction markets, LIVE. Permissionless creation; complete-set mint/redeem; resolver-gated resolution; FPMM where YES price = implied probability. The vault trades these via PredictionVenue behind the MetaVenue.
predictionMarkets._factoryComment: Permissionless one-tx create+seed: createAndSeed(marketId, collateral, questionHash, resolveTime, resolver, seedCollateral) -> deploys+seeds an FPMM, LP shares to the creator; fpmmOf(marketId) + allMarketIds() registry.

markets.question: Will MNT trade above $1.50 (USD) at 2026-09-01 00:00 UTC?

latestReplay._comment: Per-(agent,market) Brier scores committed on-chain. Same agent has independent reputation per market (e.g. momentum_v1: MNT 153565 vs ETH 201210 ppm). datasetHash is the SHA-256 of the deterministic 2-market frozen dataset.

latestConsensus._comment: Recorded ConsensusReached events, one per market (computeConsensus is also a live on-chain view). Different consensus per market from independent reputations + signals.

erc8004.note: Each Sibyl agent minted an ERC-8004 identity NFT (reused across the ledger redeploy; the NFTs persist). Full records in deployments/agent-identities.json.
